summary: This note is a brief infobox-style summary of the All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC), a trade union federation in India. It records its founding in Bombay in 1920, its first leaders, its reported membership in 2002, its affiliation with the WFTU, and its current key people and office location in New Delhi.
one_line: Profile of the All India Trade Union Congress, a major Indian trade union federation founded in Bombay in 1920.
key_facts: The All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC) was founded on 31 October 1920 in Bombay, Bombay Presidency, British India.
Lala Lajpat Rai was the first President of the All India Trade Union Congress.
Diwan Chaman Lall was the first General Secretary of the All India Trade Union Congress.
The All India Trade Union Congress had 2,677,979 members as of 2002.
The All India Trade Union Congress is affiliated with the WFTU.
Ramendra Kumar is the National President of the All India Trade Union Congress.
Gurudas Dasgupta is the General Secretary of the All India Trade Union Congress.
The All India Trade Union Congress has its office in New Delhi, India.
